title: A scheduled (delayed) Field Update runs immediately
zohoSource: Zoho CRM help (documentation; the state cannot be produced read-only in the live org)

panels.caption: delaySeconds=300 is stored but the update is applied within 3 s
Zoho: scheduled actions run at the set time
text: Scheduled actions (incl. Field Update) run at the configured time and appear under Timeline > Upcoming Actions.

For Edit / Create-or-Edit rules "the scheduled actions scheduled earlier will be deleted" if an edit makes the record stop meeting the criteria; "When a lead is converted, all the scheduled actions scheduled for the record will not be executed."
panels.flag: ZOHO DOCS — not seen on screen

rows.b: Cancel / convert / deactivate before the time

notes: This is why C-11 (lead 3e3fcd8a), H-05 (ba12d70d) and C-15 ("pending action RAN") failed on 18 Oct: the update had already happened before the edit, convert or deactivation.
